tools.name: goodgrants_get_account
tools.description: Get the Good Grants account for the API key: name, region, default language and identifiers.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_seasons
tools.description: List grant seasons (funding cycles) in the account.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_chapters
tools.description: List chapters (programme sections of a season). Filter by status or season.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_forms
tools.description: List application and report forms. Filter by form type or season.

tools.name: goodgrants_get_form
tools.description: Get one form by slug.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_rounds
tools.description: List rounds (application, reviewer or feedback periods) with their open and close dates.

tools.name: goodgrants_get_round
tools.description: Get one round by slug.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_categories
tools.description: List categories (grant streams). Filter by status, chapter, form or season.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_applications
tools.description: List grant applications. Filter by status, moderation, payment, category, chapter, form, season or title.

tools.name: goodgrants_get_application
tools.description: Get one grant application by slug, with its field values and status.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_assignments
tools.description: List reviewer assignments. Filter by status, reviewer, category, chapter, score set or season.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_score_sets
tools.description: List score sets (scoring, voting, top pick and other review modes).

tools.name: goodgrants_list_leaderboard
tools.description: List leaderboard results (ranked scores) for one score set. The score set slug is required.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_funds
tools.description: List funds (budgets) with their allocated and available amounts.

tools.name: goodgrants_get_fund
tools.description: Get one fund by slug.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_allocations
tools.description: List grant allocations (awarded amounts). Filter by slug.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_allocation_payments
tools.description: List payments made against grant allocations, with due and paid dates.

tools.name: goodgrants_list_users
tools.description: List users (applicants, reviewers and admins) with their role and confirmation status.

tools.name: goodgrants_tag_application
tools.description: Add tags to a grant application. Needs a Read / Write API key; a Read only key is refused with HTTP 403. Adding a tag twice is safe.

tools.name: goodgrants_untag_application
tools.description: Remove tags from a grant application. Needs a Read / Write API key; a Read only key is refused with HTTP 403. Tags not on the application are ignored.
